response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine Staff-level seniority, deep distributed-systems experience (e.g., micro-services handling millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby), and is currently hands-on with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq, which directly matches the role's AI-native mindset requirement. However, there is no evidence of Python experience anywhere in his skills or work history despite it being an explicit must-have, and the resume lacks clear signals of stakeholder management, agile ceremony participation, or operational/on-call ownership, making it unclear he fully meets the non-technical requirements.
strengths: Currently building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators, directly aligned with the role's AI-native engineering mindset
Strong distributed/high-throughput systems track record (e.g., micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
15+ years of diverse full-stack, staff-level experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems, including founding an open-source platform
concerns: No mention of Python in skills or work history, despite it being a core must-have requirement
Little explicit evidence of stakeholder management or cross-functional coordination with product/leadership
No clear mention of on-call rotations, incident response ownership, or formal agile/scrum experience
